purpose: Four-trial development regression comparison of Base, SFT v1, and owner-corrected SFT v2 on every Retail task that remains entity-disjoint from the 53-row teacher SFT pool.

known_limitations: All 18 tasks were used in the earlier v1 development evaluation; this is a frozen regression set, not fresh unseen evaluation.
The current Retail catalog has no additional task that is entity-disjoint from the 53-row training pool under the task-text entity gate.
The sft_v2 checkpoint hash was bound from the completed training manifest before any benchmark evaluation was run.
Agent is served by local vLLM; user simulator and NL judge use DeepSeek, whose external backend is not controlled by this repository.
The 11 test_clean tasks use the official test split for development regression only and do not support an official leaderboard or business-improvement claim.
Entity isolation covers task-definition text and the frozen training group IDs; it is not a proof of independence for every latent environment-state feature.
